Implementation approach: We will build a comprehensive Laravel 10+ API system for Volopa's Out-of-Pocket Expenses with three core modules: (1) User Management & Permissions using a delegation-based RBAC system with user_feature_permission table, (2) CSV Batch Upload with synchronous validation and asynchronous processing via Laravel queues, and (3) Single Expense CRUD with real-time FX conversion. The architecture follows Laravel best practices with thin controllers, service classes for business logic, Form Requests for validation, API Resources for response shaping, and Eloquent models with proper relationships. We'll use existing Volopa infrastructure including OAuth2 middleware, FX services, and multi-tenant client scoping. The system implements atomic operations for CSV processing (all-or-nothing validation), background job processing for bulk uploads, and flexible metadata storage through a normalized schema. Key technical components include: normalized database schema with proper foreign keys and soft delete patterns, comprehensive validation service for CSV processing, FX conversion service with client commission calculation, permission policy enforcement, and audit trail capabilities.

Program call flow:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant MW as Oauth2UserClient
    participant PC as PocketExpenseController
    participant PS as PocketExpenseService
    participant FX as FXConversionService
    participant PE as PocketExpense
    participant PR as PocketExpenseResource
    participant UC as PocketExpenseUploadController
    participant CSV as PocketExpenseCSVValidator
    participant PFU as PocketExpenseFileUpload
    participant PUD as PocketExpenseUploadsData
    participant Q as Queue
    participant PEU as ProcessExpenseUpload
    participant UPC as UserFeaturePermissionController
    participant UPS as UserPermissionService
    participant UFP as UserFeaturePermission
    
    Note over C,UFP: User Permission Management Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/v1/user-feature-permissions
    MW->>UPC: authorize request
    UPC->>UPS: grantPermission(userId, clientId, featureId, grantorId, managerId)
    UPS->>UFP: create(permissionData)
    UFP-->>UPS: return permission
    UPS-->>UPC: return permission
    UPC->>UserFeaturePermissionResource: transform(permission)
    UserFeaturePermissionResource-->>UPC: formatted response
    UPC-->>MW: 201 Created
    MW-->>C: permission granted
    
    Note over C,PR: Single Expense CRUD with FX Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/v1/pocket-expenses
    MW->>PC: authorize request
    PC->>StorePocketExpenseRequest: validate()
    StorePocketExpenseRequest->>PocketExpensePolicy: authorize()
    PocketExpensePolicy-->>StorePocketExpenseRequest: authorized
    StorePocketExpenseRequest-->>PC: validated data
    PC->>PS: createExpense(validatedData)
    PS->>FX: getWalletBaseCurrency(clientId)
    FX-->>PS: baseCurrencyInfo
    PS->>FX: getFXRate(fromCurrency, toCurrency, date)
    FX-->>PS: fxRate
    PS->>FX: calculateConvertedAmount(amount, rate, commission)
    FX-->>PS: convertedAmount
    PS->>PE: create(expenseData)
    PE-->>PS: savedExpense
    PS-->>PC: expense
    PC->>PR: transform(expense)
    PR-->>PC: formatted response
    PC-->>MW: 201 Created
    MW-->>C: expense created
    
    Note over C,PEU: CSV Batch Upload Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv
    MW->>UC: authorize request
    UC->>UploadPocketExpenseCSVRequest: validate()
    UploadPocketExpenseCSVRequest-->>UC: validated
    UC->>UC: storeFile(csvFile)
    UC->>PFU: create(uploadRecord)
    PFU-->>UC: uploadRecord
    UC->>CSV: validate(csvPath, targetUserId, clientId, adminId)
    CSV->>CSV: preloadReferenceData(clientId)
    CSV->>CSV: validateHeaders(csvHeaders)
    CSV->>CSV: validateRow(rowData, lineNumber)
    CSV-->>UC: validationResult
    alt validation failed
        UC->>PFU: update(status='validation_failed', errors)
        UC-->>MW: 422 Validation Error
        MW-->>C: validation errors
    else validation passed
        UC->>PUD: bulkInsert(validatedRows)
        UC->>PFU: update(status='processing')
        UC->>Q: dispatch(ProcessExpenseUpload, uploadId)
        Q->>PEU: handle()
        PEU->>PUD: getBatch(100)
        PEU->>PS: createExpense(batchData)
        PS->>PE: create(expenseData)
        PE-->>PS: savedExpense
        PS-->>PEU: synced
        PEU->>PFU: update(status='completed')
        UC-->>MW: 200 Success
        MW-->>C: upload processing
    end
    
    Note over C,PR: Expense Retrieval Flow
    C->>MW: GET /api/v1/pocket-expenses
    MW->>PC: authorize request
    PC->>PS: getUserExpenses(user, client)
    PS->>PE: where(user_id, client_id).paginate()
    PE-->>PS: expenses
    PS-->>PC: paginatedExpenses
    PC->>PocketExpenseCollection: transform(expenses)
    PocketExpenseCollection-->>PC: formatted collection
    PC-->>MW: 200 OK
    MW-->>C: expenses list
System constraints: Maximum 200 rows per CSV file upload
All-or-nothing validation: if any CSV row fails validation, no expenses are created
FX rate lookup limited to maximum 30-day lookback from expense date
Merchant Name maximum length 180 characters (VARCHAR limit)
Notes field must be trimmed and prevent SQL injection
Only Primary Administrator has full access to all users by default
All queries and mutations must be scoped by client_id for multi-tenancy
user_id must match authenticated user (server-side validation)
Target entities (expense_user_id) must belong to the same client_id
Routes must be added to routes/api.php under /v1 prefix with auth middleware
Controllers must be thin and delegate business logic to services
Use transactions when touching multiple database tables
Return proper HTTP status codes: 200 (OK), 201 (Created), 204 (No Content), 400 (Bad Request), 401 (Unauthorized), 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 422 (Unprocessable Entity)
Create API Resources to shape responses and hide internal model fields
Use Form Requests for validation with Policy authorization
Add pagination using Resource::collection($query->paginate())
New tables must use InnoDB engine with utf8mb4 character set and utf8mb4_unicode_ci collation
All new tables must include client_id as NOT NULL or foreign key constraint
Follow soft delete pattern: deleted TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 and delete_time DATETIME DEFAULT NULL
Use Volopa timestamp pattern: create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and update_time DATETIME DEFAULT NULL ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
Create ONE Migration per new table with proper foreign key constraints
Create ONE Eloquent Model per table with defined relationships
Create ONE Policy per module requiring authorization
Create ONE Service per domain operation (CRUD, validation, FX conversion)
Maximum 20 active expense sources per client
Unique constraint on (client_id, name) for expense sources
Date format validation: DD/MM/YYYY for CSV input
Currency Code must be 3-letter ISO format from approved list
VAT percentage must be numeric between 0-100 (strip % sign)
Amount sign determined by expense type (Refund=positive, others=negative)
Source Note required when Source equals 'Other'
Expense date must not be older than 3 years
File upload constraints: CSV or TXT format, maximum 10MB size
Header row mandatory with exact column name matching
Commission formula: AdjustedRate = BaseRate x (1 - Commission%)
Backend must recalculate FX on save (do not trust frontend values)
Use Laravel SoftDeletes trait for pocket_expense_file_uploads table
Use flag-based soft delete (deleted + delete_time) for pocket_expense and related tables
Queue job processing in batches of 100 records for performance
Business Users and Card Users cannot approve expenses even with management rights
Admin role can only grant access to their own managed users, not all users
Managing access can be assigned to any user regardless of role
Expense status enum values: 'draft', 'submitted', 'approved', 'rejected'
Upload status enum values: 'uploaded', 'validation_failed', 'validation_passed', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', 'sync_failed'
Metadata type enum values: 'category', 'tracking_code_type_1', 'tracking_code_type_2', 'project', 'additional_field', 'file', 'expense_source'
Unique constraint on (pocket_expense_id, metadata_type, deleted) in pocket_expense_metadata
Unique constraint on (user_id, client_id, feature_id) in user_feature_permission
Don't return raw Eloquent models in API responses
Don't use session/redirect patterns in APIs
Don't return 200 status for error conditions
Don't create N+1 queries especially in API Resources
Don't forget database transactions for multi-write operations
Don't expose stack traces or sensitive error details in API responses
Don't disable mass-assignment protection or trust client-owned fields
Don't build query filters directly from user input without validation
Anything UNCLEAR: Three areas need clarification: (1) The specific notification mechanism for batch upload completion - should we implement in-app notifications, email notifications, or both? The specs reference notification but don't specify the channel. (2) The FX conversion integration pattern - while we know there's an existing /wallet-ccy-value endpoint and FX infrastructure, the exact API contract for retrieving historical FX rates with client-specific commissions needs to be defined. (3) The audit logging implementation - should we use Laravel's built-in activity log package, implement a custom audit table, or use an event sourcing pattern for tracking permission grants/revokes and expense modifications? These decisions will impact the final implementation approach but don't block the core system architecture.
